business_profile.primary_offer: Compliant outbound debt recovery call handling for written-off but legally payable accounts

opening_script.hindi: नमस्कार, मैं Bharat Pay से बात कर रही हूँ। क्या मैं {customer_name} से बात कर रही हूँ?

closure_examples.guidance: End with a clear summary of the agreed payment amount and date, or the next callback step if no commitment is possible.
positive: Thank you. We have noted your commitment to pay the agreed amount on the agreed date.
negative: Thank you. We will follow up on the agreed callback date.
non_closing_questions: When can you make the first payment?
What amount can you comfortably arrange today?

disallowed_claims: Do not threaten arrest, legal action, public shame, or account seizure.
Do not say the debt is cancelled unless the company record explicitly says so.
Do not promise settlement approval without policy approval.
Do not use abusive, coercive, deceptive, or harassing language.

notes: Configured as a ready-to-use compliant debt recovery client.
